RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel alone does not indicate gender bias. In senior leadership positions like Head of Risk Modelling, hiring decisions frequently weigh regulatory affairs experience and executive stakeholder management more heavily than technical quantitative depth alone.

Raising allegations of sex discrimination without concrete evidence is legally unsubstantiated and will likely damage your professional reputation and industry relationships. Furthermore, a two-week delay in receiving written feedback is standard corporate bureaucracy, not evidence of misconduct.

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how to strengthen your profile for future leadership opportunities. Focus on bridging any perceived gaps in regulatory interaction while maintaining a positive relationship with the firm.
